# expiry-engine

> Track expirations by date, usage count or time after first use, generate reminders from rules and export them as RFC 5545 iCalendar. Python package `trysac-expiry-engine`, import name `expiry_engine`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
